fields.v: Conceptual; secondary: Proposes an approach — narrative 'structured systems synthesis' of research, benchmark audits, industrial reports, telemetry and cost reports (2024 to Sep 2026; explicitly not a PRISMA-style systematic review, no search described), proposing four constructs (Agentic SDLC Throughput Paradox, Production-Qualified Change, Verification Tax, Agentic SDLC Control Plane), an Autonomy Budget, a metric set and a research agenda

fields.v: Not SDD artefacts. Control plane records: risk class per task, execution plan (model, context strategy, harness, tool permissions, parallelism, hard budget), evidence bound to each risk class (tests, static analysis, reviewers, security scans, deployment gates), cost attribution records, machine-readable evidence bundles; versioned harnesses, prompts/policy and replayable trajectories

fields.v: Work intake -> policy/risk classifier -> execution planner -> implementation agent with optional test/verifier, review and security agents -> CI/build/tests -> security/policy gates and human escalation/approval -> deploy/canary/rollback (production qualification) -> observability -> outcome learning (PQC, escaped defects, cost, SLOs). Reliability gate ladder: requirement fit, build/type checks, unit/property tests, integration/contract tests, security/dependency policy, review/ownership, deploy/canary, production SLO/rollback, maintenance/regression

fields.v: Not an exhaustive systematic review; some 2026 sources are preprints or organisation reports; company-reported outcomes may be biased; forecasts are planning signals; cited results come from different populations and cannot be compared directly; constructs (PQC, Verification Tax, Autonomy Budget, Control Plane) are unvalidated hypotheses. Research agenda RQ1-RQ10: predictors of PQC, adaptive verification budgets, correlated verifier errors, stop rules for long-horizon agents, cost attribution to value, real defect detection by AI tests, organisation design, agent coordination, reliability evidence across model/harness changes, senior engineer skills
